A call's marker follows its type and priority.
A unit's marker follows its type and current status.
A person's marker follows an applicable role and status.

marker to its named entity before drawing an operational conclusion.

scenes.title: Save and reopen a call type base icon

captions.text: From Department Types, edit Structure Fire.
The Map Icon selector supplies a built-in choice; Custom icon
supplies the uploaded alternative.

Read the Icon guidelines: supported formats are PNG, JPEG,
GIF and WebP, up to one megabyte.
SVG is not supported.
Compare Preview on Light map, Dark map and In a list.
A bold transparent square stays readable when small.
Choose Update, then reopen the form.
Showing the current custom icon confirms the stored result,
rather than just a selected file.
